question.problem: Find the real solution to the equation $5\operatorname{tanh}⁡x=4.$
question.worked_solution:
The definition of $\operatorname{tanh}⁡x$ is

$$
\operatorname{tanh}⁡x=\frac{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}}.
$$

Substituting the above definition into the equation $5\operatorname{tanh}⁡x=4,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}5\cdot (\frac{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}}) & =4 \\ 5({e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}) & =4({e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}) \\ 5{e}^{x}-5{e}^{-x} & =4{e}^{x}+4{e}^{-x} \\ {e}^{x} & =9{e}^{-x}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we multiply both sides of the equation by ${e}^{x}$ and solve the equation as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{e}^{x}\cdot {e}^{x} & ={e}^{x}\cdot 9{e}^{-x} \\ {e}^{2x} & =9 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡({e}^{2x}) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡9 \\ 2x & =\operatorname{ln}⁡9 \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡9 \\ x & =\operatorname{ln}⁡({9}^{1/2}) \\ x & =\operatorname{ln}⁡3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the only real solution is $x=\operatorname{ln}⁡3.$
